# `from_unixtime`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
from_unixtime(unix_time[, fmt])
```

Returns `unix_time` in the specified `fmt`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- from_unixtime, example 1
> SELECT from_unixtime(0, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss');
1969-12-31 16:00:00
```

```sql
-- from_unixtime, example 2
> SELECT from_unixtime(0);
1969-12-31 16:00:00
```
